quality_decision: report each paired seed delta and both seed ranges; no p-value or universal effect threshold from n=2. Consistent signs motivate confirmation, not independent generalization proof. A sign flip is unresolved, not success.
stop_or_skip: Any freeze/input-row/label/objective/best-reload failure invalidates the affected run; it is not scientific falsification. Do not run unaccepted asset/interface; no worker-added tasks.
review_checkpoint: complete agreed batch with accepted aggregates; earlier return only for material boundary failure or decisive counterevidence
change_only: representation+input dimension change; hidden256/loss/optimization/split held fixed; cannot attribute gain to encoder alone because input parameter count differs
minimum_asset_acceptance: pinned code/tokenizer/weights+buffers digest, no-update freeze and full-row coverage fixture, cached feature SHA, interface-specific reload fixture; no training until controller registration
comparison_host: compute-H100 for lipophilicity; compute-RTX4090 for all other selected tasks, or a separately registered matched-host control if unavailable
hold_fixed: all pretrained parameters and buffers frozen
